name: twincat-mcp
description: Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 for Claude Code: live PLC variables over ADS, real-time recording, XAE build/activate/deploy, .TcPOU editing, TcUnit, HMI bindings — 151 audited tools, 5 workflow prompts, two skills (tool chains; offline Beckhoff documentation).

python_exe.title: Python executable
python_exe.description: 64-bit Python 3.12 used to bootstrap the server's private venv. 'python' if it is on PATH; otherwise the full path, e.g. C:\Users\me\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python312\python.exe. 'py' does not work here (it needs the -3 switch).

ams_net_id.title: Default target AmsNetId
ams_net_id.description: AmsNetId of the IPC to connect to when a tool call does not name one, e.g. 5.12.34.56.1.1. Leave empty to use the local runtime / per-project twincat_mcp.toml.

mode.title: Safety mode at start
mode.description: readonly | guarded | full. guarded = writes only to the allow-list and every destructive action needs confirmation.

max_mode.title: Safety mode ceiling
max_mode.description: Highest mode tc_set_mode may switch to in a session: readonly | guarded | full.

config_file.title: Config TOML (optional)
config_file.description: Full path to a twincat_mcp.toml with solution path, allow/deny lists, HMI root. Leave empty: the server then looks for ./twincat_mcp.toml in the folder Claude Code was started in, then %USERPROFILE%\.twincat_mcp\config.toml.
